locations.description:
The saved places, in the popup's order. Each entry is { "name", "lat", "lon" } or { "query" }, plus optional keys:
  name       what the popup shows; a query entry without one takes the name the geocoder answers with
  lat, lon   decimal degrees (WGS84), lat -90 .. 90, lon -180 .. 180; needed unless "query" is given
  elevation  metres above sea level (Open-Meteo corrects temperature and pressure to it); left out, it is looked
             up once through Open-Meteo and remembered
  query      a place name, optionally ", CC" with an ISO country code ("Leuven, BE"), resolved once through
             Open-Meteo's geocoder and remembered; change the text to resolve it anew
  default    true: the place the current location shows while geoclue has no fix and there is no hometown (else the
             first entry); with the current location off the popup starts on the first entry
  home       true: the hometown, shown while geoclue has no fix; with none marked, the first accepted fix is kept
An entry with neither lat + lon nor a query is skipped. Default: Brussels, below. For example:
  "locations": [
    { "name": "Antwerp", "lat": 51.22, "lon": 4.40, "elevation": 7, "default": true },
    { "name": "Leuven", "query": "Leuven, BE" }
  ],

Takes a list of objects. Default: [{"name":"Brussels","lat":50.85,"lon":4.35,"elevation":25}].

enabled.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

maxAccuracyM.description: Takes a number, 1 and up. Default: 3000.

nearSavedKm.description: Takes a number, 0.001 and up. Default: 5.

currentLocation.description:
The machine's own position, from geoclue, shown first in the list.
  enabled       ask geoclue at all. Default true.
  maxAccuracyM  a fix coarser than this many metres is refused (an IP fix is tens of km, a WiFi fix a few
                hundred m). Default 3000; a number above 0.
  nearSavedKm   a fix within this many km of a saved place takes that place's name. Default 5; a number above 0.

wind.description:
"bft" (Beaufort) | "speed" (a figure in the "speed" unit)

Takes "bft" or "speed". Default: "bft".

airQuality.description:
"ugm3" (pollutant concentrations, the only choice)

Takes "ugm3". Default: "ugm3".

date.description:
"dd/MM" | "MM/dd" | "d MMM" (the week's first day is calendars.jsonc's weekStart)

Takes "dd/MM", "MM/dd" or "d MMM". Default: "dd/MM".

view.description:
The popup's view: the one it starts a session on ("mini" | "normal" | "detailed"), and whether it comes back as you left it for the rest of the
session ("session") or opens on that one every time ("never").

look.description: Where a day's detail opens beside the popup: "end" (the right of a top bar's popup) | "start" (the left) | "far" (below it).

glyphSet.description:
TEMPORARY, while the redesigned icons are on trial: "ink" (the drawn set: solid icons in the bar's ink with one
coloured part) | "carved" (the legacy carved, full-colour set). Read live. Default "ink". The key goes when the
legacy set does.

Takes "ink" or "carved". Default: "ink".

aqiIndex.description:
The air quality index: "eaqi" (the European index, Open-Meteo / CAMS) | "belaqi" (IRCEL-CELINE's Belgian index,
1 .. 10). Default "eaqi".

Takes "eaqi" or "belaqi". Default: "eaqi".

model.description: Takes a text like best_match. Default: "best_match".

openMeteo.description:
An Open-Meteo model id (lower case, digits, _): "best_match", "knmi_harmonie_arome_netherlands", "icon_d2",
"meteofrance_arome_france_hd", "ecmwf_ifs025", ... Default "best_match".

enabled.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

kmi.description: The KMI app API: observation, warnings, pollen note, radar nowcast, KMI's daily text. Default true.

forecast.description: Takes a number, 0.1 and up. Default: 15.

airQuality.description: Takes a number, 0.1 and up. Default: 60.

kmi.description: Takes a number, 0.1 and up. Default: 15.

nowcastWhileOpen.description: Takes a number, 0.1 and up. Default: 5.

refreshMinutes.description:
Minutes each source may age before it is fetched again; nowcastWhileOpen is KMI's cadence while the popup is open.
Defaults 15, 60, 15, 5; each a number above 0.
